retrospective_ranking.method: Exact current selector rerun on an in-memory snapshot with saved predicted coordinates restored as candidate finals; only that in-memory snapshot clears verified flags. Calibration uses the full current verified correction history including evaluated images (in-sample), so this is a counterfactual rescore, not the score as it existed at prediction time.
